consoles.name: Yamaha DM3 / DM5 / DM7
consoles.label: DM
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · celý disk (súbor max. 4 GB). Disk nad 2 TB dostane exFAT (DM3 firmvér V2+, DM7 V1.5+).
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · whole disk (max. 4 GB per file). Disks over 2 TB get exFAT (DM3 firmware V2+, DM7 V1.5+).
consoles.tip_sk: USB je pripravené pre Yamaha DM.
consoles.tip_en: USB is ready for Yamaha DM.

consoles.name: Yamaha CL / QL
consoles.label: CLQL
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · oddiel max. 32 GB (Yamaha podporuje USB do 32 GB). Kľúč do 2 GB dostane FAT16.
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · partition max. 32 GB (Yamaha supports USB up to 32 GB). Sticks up to 2 GB get FAT16.
consoles.tip_sk: USB je pripravené pre CL / QL.
consoles.tip_en: USB is ready for CL / QL.

consoles.name: Yamaha LS9
consoles.label: LS9
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · oddiel max. 16 GB (Yamaha overila do 16 GB). Kľúč do 2 GB dostane FAT16. LS9 nepodporuje dlhé názvy súborov.
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · partition max. 16 GB (Yamaha verified up to 16 GB). Sticks up to 2 GB get FAT16. LS9 does not support long file names.

consoles.name: Yamaha TF
consoles.label: TF
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · celý disk, max. 2 TB, sektor 512 B (požiadavka Yamahy na nahrávanie).
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · whole disk, max. 2 TB, 512 B sectors (Yamaha recording requirement).
consoles.tip_sk: USB je pripravené pre TF. Na nahrávanie Yamaha odporúča rýchly HDD/SSD.
consoles.tip_en: USB is ready for TF. Yamaha recommends a fast HDD/SSD for recording.

consoles.name: Behringer X32 / Midas M32
consoles.label: X32
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · oddiel max. 32 GB. Pult nahráva po súboroch max. 2 GB.
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · partition max. 32 GB. The console records in files of max. 2 GB.
consoles.tip_sk: USB je pripravené pre X32 / M32.
consoles.tip_en: USB is ready for X32 / M32.

consoles.name: Behringer X Air / Midas MR
consoles.label: XAIR
consoles.tip_sk: USB je pripravené pre X Air / MR.
consoles.tip_en: USB is ready for X Air / MR.

consoles.name: Behringer WING
consoles.label: WING
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · oddiel max. 32 GB (Behringer odporúča USB do 32 GB).
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · partition max. 32 GB (Behringer recommends USB up to 32 GB).
consoles.tip_sk: USB je pripravené pre WING. Na nahrávanie použi USB 3.0 kľúč.
consoles.tip_en: USB is ready for WING. Use a USB 3.0 stick for recording.

consoles.name: Allen & Heath SQ / SQ+
consoles.label: SQ
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · cluster 32 KB · celý disk 2 GB až 2 TB.
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · 32 KB cluster · whole disk 2 GB to 2 TB.
consoles.tip_sk: Na pulte ešte daj Utility › USB Utility › Format – SQ si vytvorí priečinky.
consoles.tip_en: On the console run Utility › USB Utility › Format once more – SQ creates its folders.

consoles.name: Allen & Heath Avantis
consoles.label: AVANTIS
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · cluster 32 KB · celý disk 2 GB až 2 TB (rovnako ako dLive).
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · 32 KB cluster · whole disk 2 GB to 2 TB (same as dLive).
consoles.tip_sk: Pred nahrávaním USB naformátuj aj na pulte – vytvorí si priečinky.
consoles.tip_en: Before recording, format the USB on the console too – it creates its folders.

consoles.name: Allen & Heath dLive
consoles.label: DLIVE
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · cluster 32 KB · celý disk 2 GB až 2 TB.
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · 32 KB cluster · whole disk 2 GB to 2 TB.
consoles.tip_sk: Pred nahrávaním USB naformátuj aj na pulte – vytvorí si priečinky.
consoles.tip_en: Before recording, format the USB on the console too – it creates its folders.

consoles.name: Allen & Heath Qu
consoles.label: QU
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · cluster 32 KB · celý disk 2 GB až 2 TB.
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · 32 KB cluster · whole disk 2 GB to 2 TB.
consoles.tip_sk: Pred nahrávaním USB naformátuj aj na pulte – vytvorí si priečinky.
consoles.tip_en: Before recording, format the USB on the console too – it creates its folders.

consoles.name: Soundcraft Ui24R / Si
consoles.label: SOUNDCRAFT
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · oddiel max. 32 GB (Ui24R väčšie USB nečíta).
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · partition max. 32 GB (Ui24R does not read larger USB).

consoles.name: DiGiCo SD / Quantum
consoles.label: DIGICO
consoles.desc_sk: FAT32 · MBR · celý disk (max. 2 TB). Najkompatibilnejší formát pre session súbory.
consoles.desc_en: FAT32 · MBR · whole disk (max. 2 TB). The most compatible format for session files.
